lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: Commander,

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: I'm going to start our meeting as usual.
Wait, what meeting?

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: You mean you don't know?

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Partner,

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: it seems you've been living under a rock all this time.

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: I thought you knew about it.

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: It was thoughtless of me to assume.

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: Before we start the meeting,

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: allow me to explain.
Please.

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: Extrinsic is a special forces unit

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: which operates behind the scenes.

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: Due to the nature of our missions, we often have to make judgments.

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: Regardless of whether we are operating in the Ark or the Outpost,

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: we are always objective and impartial in our verdicts when judging someone,

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: be they individual Nikkes or an entire squad.

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: Do you have any questions

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: at this point?

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: I do!

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: For the One-Winged Dark Lord has a question.

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: I didn't ask you.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: This exterior world is always made stronger by I,

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Guillotine de Mephisto.
I don't have any questions. Keep going.

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: Very well.

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: Sharing the results of our respective analyses

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: can be beneficial for all of us,

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: so that is why we are using Bla

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: to hold recurring meetings.
Wouldn't meeting in person be preferable?

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: That may be true,

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: but to meet in person would present several...

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: Umm...

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: Shall we say, challenges.
I know what you mean.

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: I knew you would understand.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Hehe...

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: It is not easy to welcome the devil into your life.
What's the topic for today's meeting?

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: We are to analyze two squads

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: which are currently performing at a high level.

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: First up, we have the Counters.
I feel quite nervous all of a sudden...

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: They're far more balanced than they seem at first glance.

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: Anis sometimes loses her composure

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: due to the antics of Neon, the firepower enthusiast,

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: which can get them into some dangerous situations.

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: However, Rapi is a calming factor who always inspects her surroundings,

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: so they always complete their mission without any major issues.

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: Therefore, you could say that the team is a well-balanced machine.
I'd say that's an accurate assessment.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: This is all rather unexpected.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: I thought they were total newbies.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: However, Partner and the Counters seem to be a good match for each other.
We truly are.

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: Next: Absolute.

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: This team has a reputation for being the best of the best.

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: They excel in nearly every category:

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: speed, combat readiness, and operational capabilities.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Indeed.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: They are like the mighty Cerebus

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: which guards the underworld.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Especially that little one who dwells behind the wall.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Whenever I look upon her,

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: the One-Winged Dark Lord

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: which is sealed in my right eye goes berserk,

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: craving for a battle,

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: just once.
Are you talking about Vesti?

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: I'm impressed that you're able to follow her gibberish.
I think I'm getting the hang of it.

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: Well, not me.

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: I can barely understand her still,

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: and I have no intention of going out of my way to try and make sense of it.
Do you at least respect her analysis?

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: Why do you ask?
Because I don't think you do.

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: Guillotine's analyses are objective and accurate.

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: However, her figures of speech can be quite exasperating,

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: which leaves me reluctant to include her in the meetings.
You two are quite good together.

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: I don't think...

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Red Rose.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: What are you hiding from the One-Winged Dark Lord?

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Cast away that false persona,

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: cleanse yourself of denial and accept me!

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: You see what I have to deal with?
I hope your friendship lasts forever.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Just as the flames consume the battlefield, bound by the souls of the damned,

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: so will the Kotodama protect us.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: On this day, the One-Winged Dark Lord will once again

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: head into battle for one last hurrah up on the surface.

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: Ugh.

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: I can't take much more of this...
